method.counting: upstream_attempt only; completion and wait events excluded; retries count as separate upstream attempts
method.window: 60s rolling windows by upstream start time; usage assigned to start for observation, not a claim about upstream accounting
method.cache: cached input is a subset of input, never added twice; unknown usage is not counted as zero consumption
method.limits: observed throughput does not identify configured TPM/RPM or token bucket capacity/refill; hidden traffic and reservation/cache rules are unknown

assessment.interpretation: Observed workload throughput is not the configured TPM/RPM. Cache accounting, token reservation, burst/refill rules, external traffic and upstream shared capacity are not known.

short_request_counterexample.interpretation: The same short request was rejected after over 17 minutes without logged same-account traffic, then accepted on another account. Local minute throughput alone cannot explain all rejections.

notes: HTTP 200 accepted attempts include six client-cancelled streams that still reported usage; accepted does not always mean a fully delivered response.
Some 429 requests have no usage; zero numeric log fields are unknown consumption, not evidence of zero charge.
Retries and request_completed are not double-counted: only upstream_attempt contributes to counts.
The gateway 30-second fallback cooldown is a local policy, not evidence of upstream reset duration.
Archive header allowlist does not retain Retry-After or rate-limit headers; absence in archives does not mean upstream omitted them.
No new upstream calls or load tests were performed.
recommended_next_observations: Record per-attempt upstream Retry-After, rate-limit limit/remaining/reset headers when present, with safe header allowlist.
Record request output cap and reported cached/uncached tokens in per-attempt structured logs.
Use controlled short-input/short-output sequential requests to distinguish RPM from TPM only as a separately scoped test.
Validate whether accounts are independent quota subjects and whether there is traffic outside this gateway.
